newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Arbed says did not bid for Spain's CSI.
newsitem.headline: Arbed says did not bid for Spain's CSI.

text.p: Luxembourg steel maker Arbed SA said on Tuesday it did not bid for a stake in Spain's state-controlled steel firm Corporacion Siderurgica Integral (CSI), which is being sold off.
"Just like any steel maker we have been interested (in CSI)...but we did not place a bid (by last Friday's deadline)," Marc Schonckert, a spokesman at Arbed, told Reuters.

French steel group Usinor Sacilor said last Friday it was lodging a 3.35 billion French franc ($567.1 million) offer for 35 percent of CSI. The bid would involve a bond subscription to the tune of one billion francs.
Spanish trade unions, fearing job losses, are outraged at government privatisation plans and are planning further strike action after stoppages last week.
